verses.sloka: तस्मिन् हते राक्षससैन्यपाले प्लवङ्गमानामृषभेण युद्धे ।भीमायुधं सागरतुल्यवेगं विदुद्रुवे राक्षसराजसैन्यम् ।। ६.५९.१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tasmin hate rākṣasasainyapāle plavaṅgamānāmṛṣabheṇa yuddhe ।bhīmāyudhaṁ sāgaratulyavegaṁ vidudruve rākṣasarājasainyam ।। 6.59.1 ।।।।

translations.english: Commander in chief of the Rakshasa army killed by Neela, the bull of Vanaras, the army Rakshasas with dreadful weapons which were like the fury of an ocean, ran.
translations.hindi: भीम पराक्रमी प्रहस्त को लङ्का से बाहिर निकलते देख, शत्र - हन्ता श्रीरामचन्द्र जी ने मुसक्या कर विभीषण से कहा

verses.sloka: गत्वा ऽथ रक्षोधिपतेः शशंसुः सेनापतिं पावकसूनुशस्तम् ।तच्चापि तेषां वचनं निशम्य रक्षोधिपः क्रोधवशं जगाम ।। ६.५९.२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: gatvā 'tha rakṣodhipateḥ śaśaṁsuḥ senāpatiṁ pāvakasūnuśastam ।taccāpi teṣāṁ vacanaṁ niśamya rakṣodhipaḥ krodhavaśaṁ jagāma ।। 6.59.2 ।।।।

translations.english: Having gone to the king of Rakshasas, the survivors said, "Prahastha is killed by the son of fire god." Thereafter, the king of Rakshasas fell prey to anger.
translations.hindi: हे महाबाहो ! मुझे बतलाओ यह वीर्यंबान और बड़े डील- डौल बाला कौन निशाचर है,जिसके साथ बड़ी विशाल सेना है

verses.sloka: सङ्ख्ये प्रहस्तं निहतं निशम्य शोकार्दितः क्रोधपरीतचेताः ।उवाच तान्नैर्ऋतयोधमुख्यानिन्द्रो यथा चामरयोधमुख्यान् ।। ६.५९.३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: saṅkhye prahastaṁ nihataṁ niśamya śokārditaḥ krodhaparītacetāḥ ।uvāca tānnairṛtayodhamukhyānindro yathā cāmarayodhamukhyān ।। 6.59.3 ।।।।

translations.english: Even as Rakshasas revealed about Prahastha's death, tormented by grief and anger Ravana spoke to Rakshasa troops just as Indra spoke to celestial troops.
translations.hindi: श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के ये वचन सुन उत्तर में विभीपण ने कहा-- यह रावण का सेनापति हे । इस राक्षस का नाम प्रहस्त हे

verses.sloka: नावज्ञा रिपवे कार्या यैरिन्द्रबलसूदनः ।सूदितः सैन्यपालो मे सानुयात्रः सकुञ्जरः ।। ६.५९.४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: nāvajñā ripave kāryā yairindrabalasūdanaḥ ।sūditaḥ sainyapālo me sānuyātraḥ sakuñjaraḥ ।। 6.59.4 ।।।।

translations.english: "No low opinion to be entertained with regard to an enemy by whom my commander in chief of the army was killed, who is capable of killing the army of Indra with his followers and elephants."
translations.hindi: लङ्का में रावण के अधीन जितनी सेना है, उसमें से एक तिहाई सेना इसके अधीन है। यह असरों का चलाना जानता है और एक प्रसिद्ध पराक्रमी हे

verses.sloka: सो ऽहं रिपुविनाशाय विजयायाविचारयन् ।स्वयमेव गमिष्यामि रणशीर्षं तदद्भुतम् ।। ६.५९.५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: so 'haṁ ripuvināśāya vijayāyāvicārayan ।svayameva gamiṣyāmi raṇaśīrṣaṁ tadadbhutam ।। 6.59.5 ।।।।

translations.english: "I shall go myself without thinking to that wonderful battle scene and put an end to the enemy and succeed."

verses.sloka: अद्य तद्वानरानीकं रामं च सहलक्ष्मणम् ।निर्दहिष्यामि वाणौघैर्वनं दीप्तैरिवाग्निभिः ।। ६.५९.६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: adya tadvānarānīkaṁ rāmaṁ ca sahalakṣmaṇam ।nirdahiṣyāmi vāṇaughairvanaṁ dīptairivāgnibhiḥ ।। 6.59.6 ।।।।

translations.english: "Now I will go and burn up that army of Vanaras along with Lakshmana and Rama with the stream of my arrows just as forest fire without the use of fire."
translations.hindi: उसने वानरों की बड़ी बलवान सेना को देखा, जो उसे ( प्रहस्त को ) देख अत्यन्त कुपित हो गजे रही थी

verses.sloka: स एवमुक्त्वा ज्वलनप्रकाशं रथं तुरङ्गोत्तमराजयुक्तम् ।प्रकाशमानं वपुषा ज्वलन्तं समारुरोहामरराजशत्रुः ।। ६.५९.७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa evamuktvā jvalanaprakāśaṁ rathaṁ turaṅgottamarājayuktam ।prakāśamānaṁ vapuṣā jvalantaṁ samārurohāmararājaśatruḥ ।। 6.59.7 ।।।।

translations.english: Ravana, the enemy of the king of Devatas, having spoken like that ascended a chariot yoked to the best of horses, shining by virtue of its form (golden) and luminous like fire.
translations.hindi: % एक संस्करण में इसके पूर्व यह और है--“ग्रागच्छुति महावेगः किंरूपबलपौरुषः |? छ € रै खङ्गशक्त्यष्टियाणाशच शूलानि मुसलानि च | गदाश्च परिघाः प्रासा विविधाश्च परश्वधाः

verses.sloka: स शङ्खभैरीपणवप्रणादैरास्फोटितक्ष्वेलितसिंहनादैः ।पुण्यैः स्तवैश्चाप्यभिपूज्यमानस्तदा ययौ राक्षसराजमुख्यः ।। ६.५९.८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa śaṅkhabhairīpaṇavapraṇādairāsphoṭitakṣvelitasiṁhanādaiḥ ।puṇyaiḥ stavaiścāpyabhipūjyamānastadā yayau rākṣasarājamukhyaḥ ।। 6.59.8 ।।।।

translations.english: As the foremost king of the Rakshasas went forth, a blast of sounds of conchs, beat of drums and clapping of arms and the roaring sounds followed by the chanting of auspicious verses sung by the Rakshasas eulogizing and honouring the king highly.

verses.sloka: स शैलजीमूतनिकाशरूपैर्मांसादनैः पावकदीप्तनेत्रेः ।बभौ वृतो राक्षसराजमुख्यो भूतैर्वृतो रुद्र इवासुरेशः ।। ६.५९.९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa śailajīmūtanikāśarūpairmāṁsādanaiḥ pāvakadīptanetreḥ ।babhau vṛto rākṣasarājamukhyo bhūtairvṛto rudra ivāsureśaḥ ।। 6.59.9 ।।।।

translations.english: The Rakshasa king surrounded by Rakshasas who resembled mountains and clouds in form seemed like Rudra surrounded by asuras.

verses.sloka: ततो नगर्याः सहसा महौजा निष्क्रम्य तद्वानरसैन्यमुग्रम् ।महार्णवाभ्रस्तनितं ददर्शं समुद्यतं पादपशैलहस्तम् ।। ६.५९.१० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tato nagaryāḥ sahasā mahaujā niṣkramya tadvānarasainyamugram ।mahārṇavābhrastanitaṁ dadarśaṁ samudyataṁ pādapaśailahastam ।। 6.59.10 ।।।।

translations.english: Thereafter, Ravana possessed with great splendour stopped at the city and saw the army of Vanaras collected together looking like an ocean of clouds wielding trees and rocks.
translations.hindi: परस्पर दोनों सेनाएँ जब भिड़ गई ; तब बड़ा बिकट युद्ध हुआ । दोनों ही ओर के योद्धा, एक दूसरे के ऊपर शिलां और बार्णो की वर्षा करने लगे

verses.sloka: तद्राक्षसानीकमतिप्रचण्डमालोक्य रामो भुजगेन्द्रबाहुः ।विभीषणं शस्त्रभृतां वरिष्ठमुवाच सेनानुगतः पृथुश्रीः ।। ६.५९.११ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tadrākṣasānīkamatipracaṇḍamālokya rāmo bhujagendrabāhuḥ ।vibhīṣaṇaṁ śastrabhṛtāṁ variṣṭhamuvāca senānugataḥ pṛthuśrīḥ ।। 6.59.11 ।।।।

translations.english: Rama, whose arms were like the king of serpents, shining with splendour, followed by army, seeing the army of Rakshasas exceedingly furious, spoke to Vibheeshana the foremost of the wielder of weapons.

verses.sloka: नानापताकाध्वजशस्त्रजुष्टं प्रासासिशूलायुधशस्त्रजुष्टम् ।सैन्यं गजेन्द्रोपमनागजुष्टं कस्येदमक्षोभ्यमभीरुजुष्टम् ।। ६.५९.१२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: nānāpatākādhvajaśastrajuṣṭaṁ prāsāsiśūlāyudhaśastrajuṣṭam ।sainyaṁ gajendropamanāgajuṣṭaṁ kasyedamakṣobhyamabhīrujuṣṭam ।। 6.59.12 ।।।।

translations.english: "Under whose command is this unshakeable army with several kinds of flags, posts and weapons armed with missiles, tridents, swords spikes and darts, with elephants the size of Mahendra mountain"

verses.sloka: ततस्तु रामस्य निशम्य वाक्यं विभीषणः शक्रसमानवीर्यः ।शशंस रामस्य बलप्रवेकं महात्मनां राक्षसपुङ्गवानाम् ।। ६.५९.१३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tatastu rāmasya niśamya vākyaṁ vibhīṣaṇaḥ śakrasamānavīryaḥ ।śaśaṁsa rāmasya balapravekaṁ mahātmanāṁ rākṣasapuṅgavānām ।। 6.59.13 ।।।।

translations.english: Thereupon, Vibheeshana, equal to Indra in valour, on hearing the great soul Rama, revealed about the Rakshasa army endowed with great strength.

verses.sloka: यो ऽसौ गजस्कन्धगतो महात्मा नवोदितार्कोपमताम्रवक्त्रः ।प्रकम्पयन्नागशिरो ऽभ्युपैति ह्यकम्पनं त्वेनमवेहि राजन् ।। ६.५९.१४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: yo 'sau gajaskandhagato mahātmā navoditārkopamatāmravaktraḥ ।prakampayannāgaśiro 'bhyupaiti hyakampanaṁ tvenamavehi rājan ।। 6.59.14 ।।।।

translations.english: "O King! the one seated on the elephant, by whose weight the elephant head is shaking, whose coppery face is like the rising sun, a gigantic one is Akampana."

verses.sloka: यो ऽसौ रथस्थो मृगराजकेतुर्धून्वन् धनुः शक्रधनुःप्रकाशम् ।करीव भात्युग्रविवृत्तदंष्ट्रः स इन्द्रजिन्नाम वरप्रधानः ।। ६.५९.१५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: yo 'sau rathastho mṛgarājaketurdhūnvan dhanuḥ śakradhanuḥprakāśam ।karīva bhātyugravivṛttadaṁṣṭraḥ sa indrajinnāma varapradhānaḥ ।। 6.59.15 ।।।।

translations.english: "The one on the chariot, distinguished by the sign of a lion, and making sound with his bow, splendid as Indra's bow with terrific teeth projected forward looks like an elephant, eminent by virtue of the boons bestowed is Indrajith by name."

verses.sloka: यश्चैष विन्ध्यास्तमहेन्द्रकल्पो धन्वी रथस्थो ऽतिरथो ऽतिवीरः ।विस्फारयंश्चापमतुल्यमानं नाम्ना ऽतिकायो ऽतिविवृद्धकायः ।। ६.५९.१६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: yaścaiṣa vindhyāstamahendrakalpo dhanvī rathastho 'tiratho 'tivīraḥ ।visphārayaṁścāpamatulyamānaṁ nāmnā 'tikāyo 'tivivṛddhakāyaḥ ।। 6.59.16 ।।।।

translations.english: "He who resembles Vindhya Mountain in the west (where the sun sets) and the Mahendra mountain (in size) seated on the chariot, is a great chariotwarrior, a hero unequalled in size, wielding a bow whose body is grown out of size, who is coming in sight is by name Atikaya."

verses.sloka: यो ऽसौ नवार्कोदितताम्रचक्षुरारुह्य घण्टानिनदप्रणादम् ।गजं खरं गर्जति वै महात्मा महोदरो नाम स एष वीरः ।। ६.५९.१७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: yo 'sau navārkoditatāmracakṣurāruhya ghaṇṭāninadapraṇādam ।gajaṁ kharaṁ garjati vai mahātmā mahodaro nāma sa eṣa vīraḥ ।। 6.59.17 ।।।।

translations.english: "He whose eyes are coppery red in anger, who rides on elephant resembles the beating of bells, roars in harsh tone are a great courageous one by the name Mahodara."

verses.sloka: यो ऽसौ हयं काञ्चनचित्रभाण्डमारुह्य सन्ध्याभ्रगिरिप्रकाशम् ।प्रासं समुद्यम्य मरीचिनद्धं पिशाच एषो ऽशनितुल्यवेगः ।। ६.५९.१८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: yo 'sau hayaṁ kāñcanacitrabhāṇḍamāruhya sandhyābhragiriprakāśam ।prāsaṁ samudyamya marīcinaddhaṁ piśāca eṣo 'śanitulyavegaḥ ।। 6.59.18 ।।।।

translations.english: "He who is mounted on horses decorated with gold shining, like a mountain crowned with cloud, radiant as the Sun holding the shining yokes coming at high speed is by name Pisacha."

verses.sloka: यश्चैष शूलं निशितं प्रगृह्य विद्युत्प्रभं किङ्करवज्रवेगम् ।वृषेन्द्रमास्थाय गिरिप्रकाशमायाति यो ऽसौ त्रिशिरा यशस्वी ।। ६.५९.१९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: yaścaiṣa śūlaṁ niśitaṁ pragṛhya vidyutprabhaṁ kiṅkaravajravegam ।vṛṣendramāsthāya giriprakāśamāyāti yo 'sau triśirā yaśasvī ।। 6.59.19 ।।।।

translations.english: "He who comes firmly shining like lightning, surpassing thunderbolt in speed, seizing a trident, riding a Lordly bull shining like a mountain is the famous Trisira."

verses.sloka: असौ च जीमूतनिकाशरूपः कुम्भः पृथुव्यूढसुजातवक्षाः ।समाहितः पन्नगराजकेतुर्विस्फारयन् भाति धनुर्विधून्वन् ।। ६.५९.२० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: asau ca jīmūtanikāśarūpaḥ kumbhaḥ pṛthuvyūḍhasujātavakṣāḥ ।samāhitaḥ pannagarājaketurvisphārayan bhāti dhanurvidhūnvan ।। 6.59.20 ।।।।

translations.english: "There comes Kumbha whose form is like a cloud in form, whose chest is fleshy and broad. He is fully prepared, coming with a sign of the king of serpents (Vasuki) stretching his bow."

verses.sloka: यश्चैष जाम्बूनदवज्रजुष्टं दीप्तं सधूमं परिघं प्रगृह्य ।आयाति रक्षोबलकेतुभूतस्त्वसौ निकुम्भो ऽद्भुतघोरकर्मा ।। ६.५९.२१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: yaścaiṣa jāmbūnadavajrajuṣṭaṁ dīptaṁ sadhūmaṁ parighaṁ pragṛhya ।āyāti rakṣobalaketubhūtastvasau nikumbho 'dbhutaghorakarmā ।। 6.59.21 ।।।।

translations.english: "There comes Nikumbha, studded with gold and diamonds, shining and smoky, who is the chief of Rakshasa army seizing an iron club, is capable of wonderful and terrific deeds."

verses.sloka: यश्चैष चापासिशरौघजुष्टं पताकिनं पावकदीप्तरूपम् ।रथं समास्थाय विभात्युदग्रो नरान्तको ऽसौ नगशृङ्गयोधी ।। ६.५९.२२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: yaścaiṣa cāpāsiśaraughajuṣṭaṁ patākinaṁ pāvakadīptarūpam ।rathaṁ samāsthāya vibhātyudagro narāntako 'sau nagaśṛṅgayodhī ।। 6.59.22 ।।।।

translations.english: Again, comes Naranthaka, with multitude of swords and arrows, mounted on top of a chariot with flags, blazing like fire, who fights with mountain peaks.

verses.sloka: यश्चैष नानाविधघोररूपैर्व्याघ्रोष्ट्रनागेन्द्रमृगाश्ववक्त्रैः ।भूतैर्वृतो भाति विवृत्तनेत्रैः सो ऽसौ सुराणामपि दर्पहन्ता ।। ६.५९.२३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: yaścaiṣa nānāvidhaghorarūpairvyāghroṣṭranāgendramṛgāśvavaktraiḥ ।bhūtairvṛto bhāti vivṛttanetraiḥ so 'sau surāṇāmapi darpahantā ।। 6.59.23 ।।।।

translations.english: "One who is surrounded by several hideous forms, like heads of tigers, camels, Lordly elephants and horses, rolling eyes, just as Rudra by his attendants, who is surrounded by Rakshasas and is humbled by the pride of even Devatas, over him shines the white canopy resembling the moon with slender ribs is the king of Rakshasas."

verses.sloka: यत्रैतदिन्दुप्रतिमं विभाति च्छत्रं सितं सूक्ष्मशलाकमग्र्यम् ।अत्रैष रक्षोधिपतिर्महात्मा भूतैर्वृतो रुद्र इवावभाति ।। ६.५९.२४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: yatraitadindupratimaṁ vibhāti cchatraṁ sitaṁ sūkṣmaśalākamagryam ।atraiṣa rakṣodhipatirmahātmā bhūtairvṛto rudra ivāvabhāti ।। 6.59.24 ।।।।

translations.english: "One who is surrounded by several hideous forms, like heads of tigers, camels, Lordly elephants and horses, rolling eyes, just as Rudra by his attendants, who is surrounded by Rakshasas and is humbled by the pride of even Devatas, over him shines the white canopy resembling the moon with slender ribs is the king of Rakshasas."

verses.sloka: असौ किरीटी चलुकुण्डलास्यो नगेन्द्रविन्ध्योपमभीमकायः ।महेन्द्रवैवस्वतदर्पहन्ता रक्षोधिपः सूर्य इवावभाति ।। ६.५९.२५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: asau kirīṭī calukuṇḍalāsyo nagendravindhyopamabhīmakāyaḥ ।mahendravaivasvatadarpahantā rakṣodhipaḥ sūrya ivāvabhāti ।। 6.59.25 ।।।।

translations.english: "There is the king of Rakshasas shining like Sun, whose countenance shines with hanging earrings, of terrible form like the Himalayas and Vindhya, who has humbled the pride of Mahendra and Yama."

verses.sloka: प्रत्युवाच ततो रामो विभीषणमरिन्दमम् ।अहो दीप्तो महातेजा रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः ।। ६.५९.२६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: pratyuvāca tato rāmo vibhīṣaṇamarindamam ।aho dīpto mahātejā rāvaṇo rākṣaseśvaraḥ ।। 6.59.26 ।।।।

translations.english: Then Rama the scourge of enemies replied Vibheeshana, "Oh! Ravana! King of Rakshasas is endowed with luminous glory."

verses.sloka: आदित्य इव दुष्प्रेक्षो रश्मिभिर्भाति रावणः ।सुव्यक्तं लक्षये ह्यस्य रूपं तेजस्समावृतम् ।। ६.५९.२७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: āditya iva duṣprekṣo raśmibhirbhāti rāvaṇaḥ ।suvyaktaṁ lakṣaye hyasya rūpaṁ tejassamāvṛtam ।। 6.59.27 ।।।।

translations.english: "Ravana blazing like the sun is difficult to gaze even. His shine is spread all over and not perceptible to discern."

verses.sloka: देवदानववीराणां वपुर्नैवंविधं भवेत् ।यादृशं राक्षसेन्द्रस्य वपुरेतत् प्रकाशते ।। ६.५९.२८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: devadānavavīrāṇāṁ vapurnaivaṁvidhaṁ bhavet ।yādṛśaṁ rākṣasendrasya vapuretat prakāśate ।। 6.59.28 ।।।।

translations.english: Among the Devas and Danavas such brilliance is not there. He shines so brightly.

verses.sloka: सर्वे पर्वतसङ्काशाः सर्वे पर्वतयोधिनः ।सर्वे दीप्तायुधधरा योधाश्चास्य महौजसः ।। ६.५९.२९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sarve parvatasaṅkāśāḥ sarve parvatayodhinaḥ ।sarve dīptāyudhadharā yodhāścāsya mahaujasaḥ ।। 6.59.29 ।।।।

translations.english: "The great warriors of Ravana fighting in war are like mountains and all fought with mountains and glowing weapons."

verses.sloka: भाति राक्षसराजो ऽसौ प्रदीप्तैर्भीमविक्रमैः ।भूतैः परिवृतस्तीक्ष्णैर्देहवद्भिरिवान्तकः ।। ६.५९.३० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: bhāti rākṣasarājo 'sau pradīptairbhīmavikramaiḥ ।bhūtaiḥ parivṛtastīkṣṇairdehavadbhirivāntakaḥ ।। 6.59.30 ।।।।

translations.english: "The Rakshasa king is surrounded by sharp, furious beings of terrible valour shining like the god of death."

verses.sloka: दिष्ट्या ऽयमद्य पापात्मा मम दृष्टिपथं गतः ।अद्य क्रोधं विमोक्ष्यामि सीताहरणसम्भवम् ।। ६.५९.३१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: diṣṭyā 'yamadya pāpātmā mama dṛṣṭipathaṁ gataḥ ।adya krodhaṁ vimokṣyāmi sītāharaṇasambhavam ।। 6.59.31 ।।।।

translations.english: "By his good luck, this sinful one has come under my sight. I will give vent to my wrath born of Sita's abduction."

verses.sloka: एवमुक्त्वा ततो रामो धनुरादाय वीर्यवान् ।लक्ष्मणानुचरस्तस्थौ समुद्धृत्य शरोत्तमम् ।। ६.५९.३२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: evamuktvā tato rāmo dhanurādāya vīryavān ।lakṣmaṇānucarastasthau samuddhṛtya śarottamam ।। 6.59.32 ।।।।

translations.english: Indomitable Rama having spoken in that manner, followed by Lakshmana got ready and took out an excellent bow and stood.

verses.sloka: ततः स रक्षोधिपतिर्महात्मा रक्षांसि तान्याह महाबलानि ।द्वारेषु चर्यागृहगोपुरेषु सुनिर्वृतास्तिष्ठत निर्विशङ्काः ।। ६.५९.३३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sa rakṣodhipatirmahātmā rakṣāṁsi tānyāha mahābalāni ।dvāreṣu caryāgṛhagopureṣu sunirvṛtāstiṣṭhata nirviśaṅkāḥ ।। 6.59.33 ।।।।

translations.english: There upon the great soul, the king of Rakshasas thus spoke to the strong army of Rakshasas, "Fully complacent, free from any apprehension be stationed at the gates and the buildings of the four main streets."

verses.sloka: इहागतं मां सहितं भवद्भिर्वनौकसश्छिद्रमिदं विदित्वा ।शून्यां पुरीं दुष्प्रसहां प्रमथ्य प्रधर्षयेयुः सहसा समेताः ।। ६.५९.३४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: ihāgataṁ māṁ sahitaṁ bhavadbhirvanaukasaśchidramidaṁ viditvā ।śūnyāṁ purīṁ duṣprasahāṁ pramathya pradharṣayeyuḥ sahasā sametāḥ ।। 6.59.34 ।।।।

translations.english: "Coming to know that I am here with you, this side, considering it to be a weak point, the forest dwellers may enter the vacant city and Devastate all united."

verses.sloka: विसर्जयित्वा सहितांस्ततस्तान् गतेषु रक्षस्सु यथानियोगम् ।व्यदारयद्वानरसागरौघं महाझषः पूर्णमिवार्णवौघम् ।। ६.५९.३५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: visarjayitvā sahitāṁstatastān gateṣu rakṣassu yathāniyogam ।vyadārayadvānarasāgaraughaṁ mahājhaṣaḥ pūrṇamivārṇavaugham ।। 6.59.35 ।।।।

translations.english: After the counsellors departed from there Ravana pierced through the ocean of Vanaras just as gigantic fish would pierce in the sea.

verses.sloka: तमापतन्तं सहसा समीक्ष्य दीप्तेषुचापं युधि राक्षसेन्द्रम् ।महत् समुत्पाट्य महीधराग्रं दुद्राव रक्षोधिपतिं हरीशः ।। ६.५९.३६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tamāpatantaṁ sahasā samīkṣya dīpteṣucāpaṁ yudhi rākṣasendram ।mahat samutpāṭya mahīdharāgraṁ dudrāva rakṣodhipatiṁ harīśaḥ ।। 6.59.36 ।।।।

translations.english: Watching Ravana advancing suddenly on the battlefield with great speed, Sugriva took a huge mountain top and went towards Rakshasa king.

verses.sloka: तच्छैलशृङ्गं बहुवृक्षसानुं प्रगृह्य चिक्षेप निशाचराय ।तमापतन्तं सहसा समीक्ष्य बिभेद बाणैस्तपनीयपुङ्खैः ।। ६.५९.३७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tacchailaśṛṅgaṁ bahuvṛkṣasānuṁ pragṛhya cikṣepa niśācarāya ।tamāpatantaṁ sahasā samīkṣya bibheda bāṇaistapanīyapuṅkhaiḥ ।। 6.59.37 ।।।।

translations.english: Seizing mountain tops whose slopes were filled with trees Sugriva hurled at the night rangers. Watching this Ravana quickly broke them with his arrows fixed with golden shafts.

verses.sloka: तस्मिन् प्रवृद्धोत्तमसानुवृक्षे शृङ्गे विकीर्णे पतिते पृथिव्याम् ।महाहिकल्पं शरमन्तकाभं समाददे राक्षसलोकनाथः ।। ६.५९.३८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tasmin pravṛddhottamasānuvṛkṣe śṛṅge vikīrṇe patite pṛthivyām ।mahāhikalpaṁ śaramantakābhaṁ samādade rākṣasalokanāthaḥ ।। 6.59.38 ।।।।

translations.english: After that slope covered with excellent trees had fallen on the ground and broken, Ravana got readied with an arrow as if for arranging destruction like the spirit of death.

verses.sloka: स तं गृहीत्वा ऽनिलतुल्यवेगं सविस्फुलिङ्गज्वलनप्रकाशम् ।बाणं महेन्द्राशनितुल्यवेगं चिक्षेप सुग्रीववधाय रुष्टः ।। ६.५९.३९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa taṁ gṛhītvā 'nilatulyavegaṁ savisphuliṅgajvalanaprakāśam ।bāṇaṁ mahendrāśanitulyavegaṁ cikṣepa sugrīvavadhāya ruṣṭaḥ ।। 6.59.39 ।।।।

translations.english: Seizing an arrow which shone like sparks of fire and had the speed of wind, nay vied with thunderbolt of Indra in speed, he (Ravana) released an arrow in anger.

verses.sloka: स सायको रावणबाहुमुक्तः शक्राशनिप्रख्यवपुः शिताग्रः ।सुग्रीवमासाद्य बिभेद वेगाद् गुहेरिता क्रौञ्चमिवोग्रशक्तिः ।। ६.५९.४० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa sāyako rāvaṇabāhumuktaḥ śakrāśaniprakhyavapuḥ śitāgraḥ ।sugrīvamāsādya bibheda vegād guheritā krauñcamivograśaktiḥ ।। 6.59.40 ।।।।

translations.english: That arrow released from Ravana's arm, which was hard and sharp as the thunderbolt of Indra, pierced Sugriva just as the sharp thorn edged spear of Guha penetrated Krauncha mountain.

verses.sloka: स सायकार्तो विपरीतचेताः कूजन् पृथिव्यां निपपात वीरः ।तं प्रेक्ष्य भूमौ पतितं विसञ्ज्ञं नेदुः प्रहृष्टा युधि यातुधानाः ।। ६.५९.४१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa sāyakārto viparītacetāḥ kūjan pṛthivyāṁ nipapāta vīraḥ ।taṁ prekṣya bhūmau patitaṁ visañjñaṁ neduḥ prahṛṣṭā yudhi yātudhānāḥ ।। 6.59.41 ।।।।

translations.english: That hero (Sugriva) hurt by the arrow lost senses and fell on the ground groaning in the battlefield. Seeing that the Rakshasas shouted joyfully overtaken by evil spirits.

verses.sloka: ततो गवाक्षो गवयः सुदंष्ट्रस्तथर्षभो ज्योतिमुखो नभश्च ।शैलान् समुद्यम्य विवृद्धकायाः प्रदुद्रुवुस्तं प्रति राक्षसेन्द्रम् ।। ६.५९.४२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tato gavākṣo gavayaḥ sudaṁṣṭrastatharṣabho jyotimukho nabhaśca ।śailān samudyamya vivṛddhakāyāḥ pradudruvustaṁ prati rākṣasendram ।। 6.59.42 ।।।।

translations.english: Thereafter Gavaksha, Gavaya, Sudamshtra, Rshaba, Jyothimukha and Nala increasing their body size rushed towards the king of Rakshasas.

verses.sloka: तेषां प्रहारान् स चकार मोघान् रक्षोधिपो बाणगणैः शिताग्रैः ।तान् वानरेन्द्रानपि बाणजालैर्बिभेद जाम्बूनदचित्रपुङ्खैः ।। ६.५९.४३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: teṣāṁ prahārān sa cakāra moghān rakṣodhipo bāṇagaṇaiḥ śitāgraiḥ ।tān vānarendrānapi bāṇajālairbibheda jāmbūnadacitrapuṅkhaiḥ ।। 6.59.43 ।।।।

translations.english: The Rakshasa Lord made the mountain peaks useless by the hundreds of arrows released by him. The streams of arrows with golden shafts could resist the Rakshasas and strike the Vanara king.

verses.sloka: ते वानरेन्द्रास्त्रिदशारिबाणैर्भिन्ना विपेतुर्भुवि भीमकायाः ।ततस्तु तद्वानरसैन्यमुग्रं प्रच्छादयामास स बाणजालैः ।। ६.५९.४४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: te vānarendrāstridaśāribāṇairbhinnā vipeturbhuvi bhīmakāyāḥ ।tatastu tadvānarasainyamugraṁ pracchādayāmāsa sa bāṇajālaiḥ ।। 6.59.44 ।।।।

translations.english: The Vanara leaders of fierce form torn by the streams of sharp arrows discharged in the three directions fell covering the ground.

verses.sloka: ते वध्यमानाः पतिताः प्रवीरा नानद्यमाना भयशल्यविद्धाः ।शाखामृगा रावणसायकार्ता जग्मुः शरण्यं शरणं स्म रामम् ।। ६.५९.४५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: te vadhyamānāḥ patitāḥ pravīrā nānadyamānā bhayaśalyaviddhāḥ ।śākhāmṛgā rāvaṇasāyakārtā jagmuḥ śaraṇyaṁ śaraṇaṁ sma rāmam ।। 6.59.45 ।।।।

translations.english: Those monkeys struck and fallen by the piercing of arrows shrieking went to seek refuge from Rama.

verses.sloka: ततो महात्मा स धनुर्धनुष्मानादाय रामः सहसा जगाम ।तं लक्ष्मणः प्राञ्जलिरभ्युपेत्य उवाच वाक्यं परमार्थयुक्तम् ।। ६.५९.४६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tato mahātmā sa dhanurdhanuṣmānādāya rāmaḥ sahasā jagāma ।taṁ lakṣmaṇaḥ prāñjalirabhyupetya uvāca vākyaṁ paramārthayuktam ।। 6.59.46 ।।।।

translations.english: The great soul Rama who was holding a bow went seizing it. Lakshmana approached him immediately with folded hands and addressed Rama with words consonant with truth.

verses.sloka: काममार्यः सुपर्याप्तो वधायास्य दुरात्मनः ।विधमिष्याम्यहं नीचमनुजानीहि मां प्रभो ।। ६.५९.४७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: kāmamāryaḥ suparyāpto vadhāyāsya durātmanaḥ ।vidhamiṣyāmyahaṁ nīcamanujānīhi māṁ prabho ।। 6.59.47 ।।।।

translations.english: "I will exterminate the evil minded Ravana. Oh! noble brother, may I be permitted to complete the task"

verses.sloka: तमब्रवीन्महतेजा रामः सत्यपराक्रमः ।। ६.५९.४८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tamabravīnmahatejā rāmaḥ satyaparākramaḥ ।। 6.59.48 ।।।।

translations.english: Sri Rama, who was highly energetic and truthful in enthusiasm to succeed, told Lakshmana, "You go and be careful in the battle."

verses.sloka: गच्छ यत्नपरश्चापि भव लक्ष्मण संयुगे ।रावणो हि महावीर्यो रणे ऽद्भुतपराक्रमः ।त्रैलोक्येनापि सङ्क्रुद्धो दुष्प्रसह्यो न संशयः ।। ६.५९.४९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: gaccha yatnaparaścāpi bhava lakṣmaṇa saṁyuge ।rāvaṇo hi mahāvīryo raṇe 'dbhutaparākramaḥ ।trailokyenāpi saṅkruddho duṣprasahyo na saṁśayaḥ ।। 6.59.49 ।।।।

translations.english: "Ravana is a great hero in the battlefield. His valour in war is wonderful. He is angry but none can withstand him in the three worlds."

verses.sloka: तस्य च्छिद्राणि मार्गस्व स्वच्छिद्राणि च लक्षय ।चक्षुषा धनुषा यत्नाद्रक्षात्मानं समाहितः ।। ६.५९.५० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tasya cchidrāṇi mārgasva svacchidrāṇi ca lakṣaya ।cakṣuṣā dhanuṣā yatnādrakṣātmānaṁ samāhitaḥ ।। 6.59.50 ।।।।

translations.english: "Remaining alert, apply your arrows in the direction of his arrows. Looking at his arrows carefully, making an effort to protect yourself, set your bow."

verses.sloka: राघवस्य वचः श्रुत्वा परिष्वज्याभिपूज्य च ।अभिवाद्य ततो रामं ययौ सौमित्रिराहवम् ।। ६.५९.५१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: rāghavasya vacaḥ śrutvā pariṣvajyābhipūjya ca ।abhivādya tato rāmaṁ yayau saumitrirāhavam ।। 6.59.51 ।।।।

translations.english: On hearing Raghava's words, son of Sumitra embraced him and offered prayers, paying respects sallied forth for the encounter.

verses.sloka: स रावणं वारणहस्तबाहुर्ददर्श दीप्तोद्यतभीमचापम् ।प्रच्छादयन्तं शरवृष्टिजालैस्तान् वानरान् भिन्नविकीर्णदेहान् ।। ६.५९.५२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa rāvaṇaṁ vāraṇahastabāhurdadarśa dīptodyatabhīmacāpam ।pracchādayantaṁ śaravṛṣṭijālaistān vānarān bhinnavikīrṇadehān ।। 6.59.52 ।।।।

translations.english: He saw Ravana, endowed with round shoulders like elephant trunks, with fierce bow glowing and the broken bodies of Vanaras spread all over. Ravana was showering nets of arrows and instigating vanaras.

verses.sloka: तमालोक्य महातेजा हनुमान् मारुतात्मजः ।निवार्य शरजालानि प्रदुर्द्राव स रावणम् ।। ६.५९.५३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tamālokya mahātejā hanumān mārutātmajaḥ ।nivārya śarajālāni pradurdrāva sa rāvaṇam ।। 6.59.53 ।।।।

translations.english: The son of the wind god, Hanuman, a brilliant one seeing Ravana, obstructed the stream of arrows and darted towards him.

verses.sloka: रथं तस्य समासाद्य भुजमुद्यम्य दक्षिणम् ।त्रासयन् रावणं धीमान् हनुमान् वाक्यमब्रवीत् ।। ६.५९.५४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: rathaṁ tasya samāsādya bhujamudyamya dakṣiṇam ।trāsayan rāvaṇaṁ dhīmān hanumān vākyamabravīt ।। 6.59.54 ।।।।

translations.english: Courageous Hanuman seeing the chariot of Ravana lifting his right arm menacing him spoke these words.

verses.sloka: देवदानवगन्धर्वैर्यक्षैश्च सह राक्षसैः ।अवध्यत्वं त्वया प्राप्तं वानरेभ्यस्तु ते भयम् ।। ६.५९.५५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: devadānavagandharvairyakṣaiśca saha rākṣasaiḥ ।avadhyatvaṁ tvayā prāptaṁ vānarebhyastu te bhayam ।। 6.59.55 ।।।।

translations.english: "Your life is surely secure from gods, demons, Gandharvas and Yakshas and Rakshasas but you fear Vanaras."

verses.sloka: एष मे दक्षिणो बाहुः पञ्चशाखः समुद्यतः ।विधमिष्यति ते देहाद्भूतात्मानं चिरोषितम् ।। ६.५९.५६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: eṣa me dakṣiṇo bāhuḥ pañcaśākhaḥ samudyataḥ ।vidhamiṣyati te dehādbhūtātmānaṁ ciroṣitam ।। 6.59.56 ।।।।

translations.english: "I raised this right arm that way with five branches (five fingers) at you that will expel your subtle self (made up of the five subtle elements) from your body."

verses.sloka: श्रुत्वा हनुमतो वाक्यं रावणो भीमविक्रमः ।संरक्तनयनः क्रोधादिदं वचनमब्रवीत् ।। ६.५९.५७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: śrutvā hanumato vākyaṁ rāvaṇo bhīmavikramaḥ ।saṁraktanayanaḥ krodhādidaṁ vacanamabravīt ।। 6.59.57 ।।।।

translations.english: Ravana of truly fierce valour, hearing Hanuman's words, his eyes became blood red and spoke to Hanuman this way.

verses.sloka: क्षिप्रं प्रहर निश्शङ्कं स्थिरां कीर्तिमवाप्नुहि ।ततस्त्वां ज्ञातविक्रान्तं नाशयिष्यामि वानर ।। ६.५९.५८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: kṣipraṁ prahara niśśaṅkaṁ sthirāṁ kīrtimavāpnuhi ।tatastvāṁ jñātavikrāntaṁ nāśayiṣyāmi vānara ।। 6.59.58 ।।।।

translations.english: "O Vanara! Go about without any hesitation. Attain the fame of a Vanara hitting Ravana permanently. Thereafter knowing your prowess, I shall put an end to you."

verses.sloka: रावणस्य वचः श्रुत्वा वायुसूनुर्वचो ऽब्रवीत् ।प्रहृतं हि मया पूर्वमक्षं स्मर सुतं तव ।। ६.५९.५९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: rāvaṇasya vacaḥ śrutvā vāyusūnurvaco 'bravīt ।prahṛtaṁ hi mayā pūrvamakṣaṁ smara sutaṁ tava ।। 6.59.59 ।।।।

translations.english: Having heard Ravana's words, Hanuman said, "Think of your son Akshaya killed by me earlier."

verses.sloka: एवमुक्तो महातेजा रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः ।आजघानानिलसुतं तलेनोरसि वीर्यवान् ।। ६.५९.६० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: evamukto mahātejā rāvaṇo rākṣaseśvaraḥ ।ājaghānānilasutaṁ talenorasi vīryavān ।। 6.59.60 ।।।।

translations.english: Having spoken that way by Hanuman, the Lord of Rakshasas slapped his hand on Hanuman's chest.

verses.sloka: स तलाभिहतस्तेन चचाल च मुहुर्मुहुः ।स्थित्वा मुहूर्तं तेजस्वी स्थैर्यं कृत्वा महामतिः ।आजघानाभिसंक्रुद्धस्तलेनैवामरद्विषम् ।। ६.५९.६१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa talābhihatastena cacāla ca muhurmuhuḥ ।sthitvā muhūrtaṁ tejasvī sthairyaṁ kṛtvā mahāmatiḥ ।ājaghānābhisaṁkruddhastalenaivāmaradviṣam ।। 6.59.61 ।।।।

translations.english: Smacked by him (Ravana), Hanuman, a brilliant and intelligent one stood firm for a while and picking up courage, highly enraged struck the enemy of gods with his palm.

verses.sloka: ततस्तलेनाभिहतो वानरेण महात्मना ।दशग्रीवः समाधूतो यथा भूमिचले ऽचलः ।। ६.५९.६२ ।।तिः ।।।
verses.transliteration: tatastalenābhihato vānareṇa mahātmanā ।daśagrīvaḥ samādhūto yathā bhūmicale 'calaḥ ।। 6.59.62 ।।tiḥ ।।।

translations.english: Thereupon, struck by the great soul, Vanara, the ten headed Ravana was shaken like the earthquake on the mountain together.

verses.sloka: सङ्ग्रामे तं तथा दृष्ट्वा रावणं तलताडितम् ।ऋषयो वानराः सिद्धा नेदुर्देवाः सहासुरैः ।। ६.५९.६३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: saṅgrāme taṁ tathā dṛṣṭvā rāvaṇaṁ talatāḍitam ।ṛṣayo vānarāḥ siddhā nedurdevāḥ sahāsuraiḥ ।। 6.59.63 ।।।।

translations.english: Ravana hit by hand in that way in a hard manner, the siddhas, demons as well and even Devatas raised their voice.

verses.sloka: अथाश्वास्य महातेजा रावणो वाक्यमब्रवीत् ।। ६.५९.६४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: athāśvāsya mahātejā rāvaṇo vākyamabravīt ।। 6.59.64 ।।।।

translations.english: And thereafter, thus spoke extremely energetic Ravana recovering from breath, "Well done vanara. You are courageous and praiseworthy, my enemy!"

verses.sloka: साधु वानर वीर्येण श्लाघनीयो ऽसि मे रिपुः ।रावणेनैवमुक्तस्तु मारुतिर्वाक्यमब्रवीत् ।। ६.५९.६५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sādhu vānara vīryeṇa ślāghanīyo 'si me ripuḥ ।rāvaṇenaivamuktastu mārutirvākyamabravīt ।। 6.59.65 ।।।।

translations.english: Ravana having spoken in that way, Maruti said "Oh Ravana! What a shame on my valour, you survived."

verses.sloka: धिगस्तु मम वीर्येण यस्त्वं जीवसि रावण ।सकृत्तु प्रहरेदानीं दुर्बुद्धे किं विकत्थसे ।ततस्त्वां मामिका मुष्टिर्नयिष्यति यमक्षयम् ।। ६.५९.६६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: dhigastu mama vīryeṇa yastvaṁ jīvasi rāvaṇa ।sakṛttu praharedānīṁ durbuddhe kiṁ vikatthase ।tatastvāṁ māmikā muṣṭirnayiṣyati yamakṣayam ।। 6.59.66 ।।।।

translations.english: "O evil minded one, why do you brag You do this once more I will strike you once again with my fist and send you to the abode of Yama."

verses.sloka: ततो मारुतिवाक्येन क्रोदस्तस्य तदा ऽज्वलत् ।। ६.५९.६७ ।।दानीं दुर्बुद्धे किं विकत्थसे ।संरक्तनयनो यत्नान्मुष्टिमुद्यम्य दक्षिणम् ।पातयामास वेगेन वानरोरसि वीर्यवान् ।। ६.५९.६८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tato mārutivākyena krodastasya tadā 'jvalat ।। 6.59.67 ।।dānīṁ durbuddhe kiṁ vikatthase ।saṁraktanayano yatnānmuṣṭimudyamya dakṣiṇam ।pātayāmāsa vegena vānarorasi vīryavān ।। 6.59.68 ।।।।

translations.english: Consequent to Maruti speaking like that, Ravana's eyes turned red, burning with anger. The powerful Ravana lifted his right fist instantly and brought it down on his powerful enemy.

verses.sloka: हनुमान् वक्षसि व्यूढे सञ्चचाल पुनःपुनः ।। ६.५९.६९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: hanumān vakṣasi vyūḍhe sañcacāla punaḥpunaḥ ।। 6.59.69 ।।।।

translations.english: Consequent to Maruti speaking like that, Ravana's eyes turned red, burning with anger. The powerful Ravana lifted his right fist instantly and brought it down on his powerful enemy.

verses.sloka: विह्वलं तु तदा दृष्ट्वा हनुमन्तं महाबलम् ।रथेनातिरथः शीघ्रं नीलं प्रति समभ्यगात् ।। ६.५९.७० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: vihvalaṁ tu tadā dṛṣṭvā hanumantaṁ mahābalam ।rathenātirathaḥ śīghraṁ nīlaṁ prati samabhyagāt ।। 6.59.70 ।।।।

translations.english: Hit on his chest, Hanuman got hurt again and reeled. Seeing Hanuman's power, overcome with fear, the best charioteer Ravana drove quickly towards Neela.

verses.sloka: राक्षसानामधिपतिर्दशग्रीवः प्रतापवान् ।पन्नगप्रतिमैर्भीमैः परमर्मातिभेदिभिः ।शरैरादीपयामास नीलं हरिचमूपतिम् ।। ६.५९.७१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: rākṣasānāmadhipatirdaśagrīvaḥ pratāpavān ।pannagapratimairbhīmaiḥ paramarmātibhedibhiḥ ।śarairādīpayāmāsa nīlaṁ haricamūpatim ।। 6.59.71 ।।।।

translations.english: The ten headed indomitable Lord of Rakshasas with his arrows that resembled serpents, dreadful, capable of piercing into vital parts began to strike at Neela, the leader of monkeys.

verses.sloka: स शरौघसमायस्तो नीलः कपिचमूपतिः ।करेणैकेन शेलाग्रं रक्षोधिपतये ऽसृजत् ।। ६.५९.७२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa śaraughasamāyasto nīlaḥ kapicamūpatiḥ ।kareṇaikena śelāgraṁ rakṣodhipataye 'sṛjat ।। 6.59.72 ।।।।

translations.english: The ten headed indomitable Lord of Rakshasas with his arrows that resembled serpents, dreadful, capable of piercing into vital parts began to strike at Neela, the leader of monkeys.

verses.sloka: हनुमानपि तेजस्वी समाश्वस्तो महामनाः ।विप्रेक्षमाणो युद्धेप्सुः सरोषमिदमब्रवीत् ।। ६.५९.७३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: hanumānapi tejasvī samāśvasto mahāmanāḥ ।viprekṣamāṇo yuddhepsuḥ saroṣamidamabravīt ।। 6.59.73 ।।।।

translations.english: Pressured by the streams of arrows, the monkey leader, Neela single handed took up a peak of a mountain and hurled at the Lord of Rakshasas.

verses.sloka: नीलेन सह संयुक्तं रावणं राक्षसेश्वरम् ।अन्येन युद्ध्यमानस्य न युक्तमभिधावनम् ।। ६.५९.७४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: nīlena saha saṁyuktaṁ rāvaṇaṁ rākṣaseśvaram ।anyena yuddhyamānasya na yuktamabhidhāvanam ।। 6.59.74 ।।।।

translations.english: Endowed with a great mind and energetic Hanuman became alert and seeking to fight with Ravana, feeling fresh, enraged, looking at Nila said "It is not correct to attack one who is fighting with another."

verses.sloka: रावणो ऽपि महातेजास्तच्छृङ्गं सप्तभिः शरैः ।आजघान सुतीक्ष्णाग्रैस्तद्विकीर्णं पपात ह ।। ६.५९.७५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: rāvaṇo 'pi mahātejāstacchṛṅgaṁ saptabhiḥ śaraiḥ ।ājaghāna sutīkṣṇāgraistadvikīrṇaṁ papāta ha ।। 6.59.75 ।।।।

translations.english: Endowed with a great mind and energetic Hanuman became alert and seeking to fight with Ravana, feeling fresh, enraged, looking at Nila said "It is not correct to attack one who is fighting with another."

verses.sloka: तद्विकीर्णं गिरेः शृङ्गं दृष्ट्वा हरिचमूपतिः ।कालाग्निरिव जज्वाल क्रोधोन परवीरहा ।। ६.५९.७६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tadvikīrṇaṁ gireḥ śṛṅgaṁ dṛṣṭvā haricamūpatiḥ ।kālāgniriva jajvāla krodhona paravīrahā ।। 6.59.76 ।।।।

translations.english: Ravana, endowed with extraordinary energy attacked that peak hurled by Neela with seven sharp arrows and it fell broken into pieces.

verses.sloka: सो ऽश्वकर्णान् धवान् सालांश्चूतांश्चापि सुपुष्पितान् ।अन्यांश्च विविधान् वृक्षान्नीलश्चिक्षेप संयुगे ।। ६.५९.७७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: so 'śvakarṇān dhavān sālāṁścūtāṁścāpi supuṣpitān ।anyāṁśca vividhān vṛkṣānnīlaścikṣepa saṁyuge ।। 6.59.77 ।।।।

translations.english: On seeing the crushed peak, Neela, the killer of stupendous foes, shone like fire at universal destruction in anger.

verses.sloka: स तान् वृक्षान् समासाद्य प्रतिचिच्छेद रावणः ।अभ्यवर्षत् सुघोरेण शरवर्षेण पावकिम् ।। ६.५९.७८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa tān vṛkṣān samāsādya praticiccheda rāvaṇaḥ ।abhyavarṣat sughoreṇa śaravarṣeṇa pāvakim ।। 6.59.78 ।।।।

translations.english: In the battle Neela hurled Aswakarana, Sala and Mango trees in good bloom and several other trees at Ravana.

verses.sloka: अभिवृष्टः शरौघेण मेघेनेव महाचलः ।ह्रस्वं कृत्वा तदा रूपं ध्वजाग्रे निपपात ह ।। ६.५९.७९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: abhivṛṣṭaḥ śaraugheṇa megheneva mahācalaḥ ।hrasvaṁ kṛtvā tadā rūpaṁ dhvajāgre nipapāta ha ।। 6.59.79 ।।।।

translations.english: Ravana broke those trees in return and showered rain of formidable arrows at Neela.

verses.sloka: पावकात्मजमालोक्य ध्वजाग्रे समुपस्थितम् ।जज्वाल रावणः क्रोधात्ततो नीलो ननाद च ।। ६.५९.८० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: pāvakātmajamālokya dhvajāgre samupasthitam ।jajvāla rāvaṇaḥ krodhāttato nīlo nanāda ca ।। 6.59.80 ।।।।

translations.english: When Neela was covered by Ravana's arrows, it was just as clouds cover mountain peaks. Neela reduced his size and landed on top of Ravana's bow.

verses.sloka: ध्वजाग्रे धनुषश्चाग्रे किरीटाग्रे च तं हरिम् ।लक्ष्मणो ऽथ हनूमांश्च दृष्ट्वा रामश्च विस्मिताः ।। ६.५९.८१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: dhvajāgre dhanuṣaścāgre kirīṭāgre ca taṁ harim ।lakṣmaṇo 'tha hanūmāṁśca dṛṣṭvā rāmaśca vismitāḥ ।। 6.59.81 ।।।।

translations.english: Neela stood on top of the post of the bow of Ravana. On seeing that Ravana was burning in anger while Neela roared.

verses.sloka: रावणो ऽपि महातेजाः कपिलाघवविस्मितः ।अस्त्रमाहारयामास दीप्तमाग्नेयमद्भुतम् ।। ६.५९.८२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: rāvaṇo 'pi mahātejāḥ kapilāghavavismitaḥ ।astramāhārayāmāsa dīptamāgneyamadbhutam ।। 6.59.82 ।।।।

translations.english: Then, when Ravana was unable to release the arrow from the bow on Neela, who was shifting from the top of the post to the crown. Seeing that Lakshmana, Rama and Hanuman were amazed.

verses.sloka: ततस्ते चुक्रुशुर्हृष्टा लब्धलक्षाः प्लवङ्गमाः ।नीललाघवसम्भ्रान्तं दृष्ट्वा रावणमाहवे ।। ६.५९.८३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tataste cukruśurhṛṣṭā labdhalakṣāḥ plavaṅgamāḥ ।nīlalāghavasambhrāntaṁ dṛṣṭvā rāvaṇamāhave ।। 6.59.83 ।।।।

translations.english: Ravana endowed with extraordinary energy was also wonder struck at Neela's agility. Then he took up the shining shaft presided over by fire god.

verses.sloka: वानराणां च नादेन संरब्धो रावणस्तदा ।सम्भ्रमाविष्टहृदयो न किञ्चित् प्रत्यपद्यत ।। ६.५९.८४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: vānarāṇāṁ ca nādena saṁrabdho rāvaṇastadā ।sambhramāviṣṭahṛdayo na kiñcit pratyapadyata ।। 6.59.84 ।।।।

translations.english: Thereafter, seeing Neela's feat in the war, Ravana was agitated and the Vanaras were cheerful for having achieved their wish and shouted in joy.

verses.sloka: आग्नेयेनाथ संयुक्तं गृहीत्वा रावणः शरम् ।ध्वजशीर्षस्थितं नीलमुदैक्षत निशाचरः ।ततो ऽब्रवीन्महातेजा रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः ।। ६.५९.८५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: āgneyenātha saṁyuktaṁ gṛhītvā rāvaṇaḥ śaram ।dhvajaśīrṣasthitaṁ nīlamudaikṣata niśācaraḥ ।tato 'bravīnmahātejā rāvaṇo rākṣaseśvaraḥ ।। 6.59.85 ।।।।

translations.english: Provoked by the clamour of the vanaras, Ravana's heart was full of anger and did not know what to do.

verses.sloka: कपे लाघवयुक्तो ऽसि मायया परया ऽनया ।जीवितं खलु रक्षस्व यदि शक्तो ऽसि वानर ।। ६.५९.८६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: kape lāghavayukto 'si māyayā parayā 'nayā ।jīvitaṁ khalu rakṣasva yadi śakto 'si vānara ।। 6.59.86 ।।।।

translations.english: And then the night ranger Ravana taking up, fitting the arrow charged with fire, looked at Neela resting on top of the bow.

verses.sloka: तानि तान्यात्मरूपाणि सृजसि त्वमनेकशः ।। ६.५९.८७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tāni tānyātmarūpāṇi sṛjasi tvamanekaśaḥ ।। 6.59.87 ।।।।

translations.english: Ravana endowed with extraordinary energy said, "Oh monkey, you are unfair, very tricky and further deceptive."

verses.sloka: तथापि त्वां मया युक्तः सायको ऽस्त्रप्रयोजितः ।जीवतं परिरक्षन्तं जीविताद् भ्रंशयिष्यति ।। ६.५९.८८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tathāpi tvāṁ mayā yuktaḥ sāyako 'straprayojitaḥ ।jīvataṁ parirakṣantaṁ jīvitād bhraṁśayiṣyati ।। 6.59.88 ।।।।

translations.english: "Oh monkey! You are taking different forms and doing different deeds. If you have the ability, save your life."

verses.sloka: एवमुक्त्वा महाबाहू रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः ।सन्धाय बाणमस्त्रेण चमूपतिमताडयत् ।। ६.५९.८९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: evamuktvā mahābāhū rāvaṇo rākṣaseśvaraḥ ।sandhāya bāṇamastreṇa camūpatimatāḍayat ।। 6.59.89 ।।।।

translations.english: "The arrow released by me now is charged with a missile and will destroy your life. You have been protecting (changing your forms) your life."

verses.sloka: सो ऽस्त्रयुक्तेन बाणेन नीलो वक्षसि ताडितः ।निर्दह्यमानः सहसा निपपात महीतले ।। ६.५९.९० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: so 'strayuktena bāṇena nīlo vakṣasi tāḍitaḥ ।nirdahyamānaḥ sahasā nipapāta mahītale ।। 6.59.90 ।।।।

translations.english: Speaking like that, Ravana, the king of Rakshasas chanting the mantras and fixing the arrow struck the commander in chief (Neela) of the Vanara army.

verses.sloka: पितृमाहात्म्यसंयोगादात्मनश्चापि तेजसा ।जानुभ्यामपतद्भूमौ न च प्राणैर्व्ययुज्यत ।। ६.५९.९१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: pitṛmāhātmyasaṁyogādātmanaścāpi tejasā ।jānubhyāmapatadbhūmau na ca prāṇairvyayujyata ।। 6.59.91 ।।।।

translations.english: Struck by the arrow propelled by the missile (of Ravana) on the chest, Neela fell on the ground.

verses.sloka: विसञ्ज्ञं वानरं दृष्ट्वा दशग्रीवो रणोत्सुकः ।रथेनाम्बुदनादेन सौमित्रिमभिदुद्रुवे ।। ६.५९.९२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: visañjñaṁ vānaraṁ dṛṣṭvā daśagrīvo raṇotsukaḥ ।rathenāmbudanādena saumitrimabhidudruve ।। 6.59.92 ।।।।

translations.english: By virtue of his father's greatness and his own power, his life did not cease but he fell on the ground.

verses.sloka: आसाद्य रणमध्ये तु वारयित्वा स्थितो ज्वलन् ।धनुर्विस्फारयामास कम्पयन्निव मेदिनीम् ।। ६.५९.९३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: āsādya raṇamadhye tu vārayitvā sthito jvalan ।dhanurvisphārayāmāsa kampayanniva medinīm ।। 6.59.93 ।।।।

translations.english: Finding the vanara unconscious the ten headed Ravana who was eager to fight went towards Saumithri in the chariot making sounds that resembled the sound of rattling of clouds.

verses.sloka: तमाह सौमित्रिरदीनसत्त्वो विस्फारयन्तं धनुरप्रमेयम् ।अभ्येहि मामेव निशाचरेन्द्र न वानरांस्त्वं प्रतियोद्धुमर्हः ।। ६.५९.९४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tamāha saumitriradīnasattvo visphārayantaṁ dhanuraprameyam ।abhyehi māmeva niśācarendra na vānarāṁstvaṁ pratiyoddhumarhaḥ ।। 6.59.94 ।।।।

translations.english: In the midst of the battlefield stood Ravana, intercepting with his glowing bow making loud sounds as though shaking the earth.

verses.sloka: स तस्य वाक्यं प्रतिपूर्णघोषं ज्याशब्दमुग्रं च निशम्य राजा ।आसाद्य सौमित्रिमवस्थितं तं कोपान्वितो वाक्यमुवाच रक्षः ।। ६.५९.९५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa tasya vākyaṁ pratipūrṇaghoṣaṁ jyāśabdamugraṁ ca niśamya rājā ।āsādya saumitrimavasthitaṁ taṁ kopānvito vākyamuvāca rakṣaḥ ।। 6.59.95 ।।।।

translations.english: Saumithri who was not depressed in spirit (by Ravana's attack) addressing Ravana who was stretching his bow said "Oh! Lord of night rangers, Be aware. You ought not to fight with vanaras."

verses.sloka: दिष्ट्या ऽसि मे राघव दृष्टिमार्गं प्राप्तो ऽन्तगामी विपरीतबुद्धिः ।अस्मिन् क्षणे यास्यसि मृत्युदेशं संसाद्यमानो मम बाणजालैः ।। ६.५९.९६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: diṣṭyā 'si me rāghava dṛṣṭimārgaṁ prāpto 'ntagāmī viparītabuddhiḥ ।asmin kṣaṇe yāsyasi mṛtyudeśaṁ saṁsādyamāno mama bāṇajālaiḥ ।। 6.59.96 ।।।।

translations.english: Hearing the challenging statement of the king of Rakshasas and hearing the vibrating sound, Saumithri standing close by spoke these wrathful words.

verses.sloka: तमाह सौमित्रिरविस्मयानो गर्जन्तमुद्वृत्तसिताग्रदंष्ट्रम् ।राजन्न गर्जन्ति महाप्रभावा विकत्थसे पापकृतां वरिष्ठ ।। ६.५९.९७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tamāha saumitriravismayāno garjantamudvṛttasitāgradaṁṣṭram ।rājanna garjanti mahāprabhāvā vikatthase pāpakṛtāṁ variṣṭha ।। 6.59.97 ।।।।

translations.english: "Oh Raghava! You have come under the path of my sight. You are going to meet your end. You who are perverted in mind, struck by a stream of my arrows will reach the abode of death this very moment."

verses.sloka: जानामि वीर्यं तव राक्षसेन्द्र बलं प्रतापं च पराक्रमं च ।अवस्थितो ऽहं शरचापपाणिरागच्छ किं मोघविकत्थनेन ।। ६.५९.९८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: jānāmi vīryaṁ tava rākṣasendra balaṁ pratāpaṁ ca parākramaṁ ca ।avasthito 'haṁ śaracāpapāṇirāgaccha kiṁ moghavikatthanena ।। 6.59.98 ।।।।

translations.english: Saumithri, not surprised at the screaming of Ravana with his projected teeth, said, "You are great in sinful action. People of great valour do not display such bluster. Do not shout like that."

verses.sloka: स एवमुक्तः कुपितः ससर्ज रक्षोधिपः सप्त शरान् सुपुङ्खान् ।तान् लक्ष्मणः काञ्चनचित्रपुङ्खैश्चिच्छेद बाणैर्निशिताग्रधारैः ।। ६.५९.९९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa evamuktaḥ kupitaḥ sasarja rakṣodhipaḥ sapta śarān supuṅkhān ।tān lakṣmaṇaḥ kāñcanacitrapuṅkhaiściccheda bāṇairniśitāgradhāraiḥ ।। 6.59.99 ।।।।

translations.english: "Your valour, heroism, strength and prowess are known to me. I stand firmly with bow and arrow come on. What is the use of bragging"

verses.sloka: तान् प्रेक्षमाणः सहसा निकृत्तान्निकृत्तभोगानिव पन्नगेन्द्रान् ।लङ्केश्वरः क्रोधवशं जगाम ससर्ज चान्यान्निशितान् पृषत्कान् ।। ६.५९.१०० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tān prekṣamāṇaḥ sahasā nikṛttānnikṛttabhogāniva pannagendrān ।laṅkeśvaraḥ krodhavaśaṁ jagāma sasarja cānyānniśitān pṛṣatkān ।। 6.59.100 ।।।।

translations.english: Lakshmana, having spoken in that manner, the Lord of Rakshasas released seven arrows with beautiful plumes. Lakshmana tore them into pieces with sharp pointed and sharpheaded arrows with gold shafts.

verses.sloka: स बाणवर्षं तु ववर्ष तीव्रं रामानुजः कार्मुकसम्प्रयुक्तम् ।क्षुरार्धचन्द्रोत्तमकर्णिभल्लैः शरांश्च चिच्छेद न चुक्षुभे च ।। ६.५९.१०१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa bāṇavarṣaṁ tu vavarṣa tīvraṁ rāmānujaḥ kārmukasamprayuktam ।kṣurārdhacandrottamakarṇibhallaiḥ śarāṁśca ciccheda na cukṣubhe ca ।। 6.59.101 ।।।।

translations.english: Seeing the arrows cut down with force broken pieces like coils of serpents, the Lord of Lanka overtaken by anger let go another sharp arrow.

verses.sloka: स बाणजालान्यथ तानि तानि मोघानि पश्यं स्त्रिदशारिराजः ।विसिष्मिये लक्ष्मणलाघवेन पुनश्च बाणान्निशितान् मुमोच ।। ६.५९.१०२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa bāṇajālānyatha tāni tāni moghāni paśyaṁ stridaśārirājaḥ ।visiṣmiye lakṣmaṇalāghavena punaśca bāṇānniśitān mumoca ।। 6.59.102 ।।।।

translations.english: The brother of Rama stretched his bow into a circle and showered rain of piercing arrows. He tore the arrows of his enemy with his arrows Kshura, Ardhachandra, karni and Balan without nay, perturbance.

verses.sloka: स लक्ष्मणश्चाशु शरान् शिताग्रान् महेन्द्रवज्राशनितुल्यवेगान् ।सन्धाय चापे ज्वलनप्रकाशान् ससर्ज रक्षोधिपतेर्वधाय ।। ६.५९.१०३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa lakṣmaṇaścāśu śarān śitāgrān mahendravajrāśanitulyavegān ।sandhāya cāpe jvalanaprakāśān sasarja rakṣodhipatervadhāya ।। 6.59.103 ।।।।

translations.english: Ravana, the enemy of gods seeing all his streams of arrows ineffective, was astonished at Lakshmana's skill, and let go sharp arrows again and again.

verses.sloka: स तान् प्रचिच्छेद हि राक्षसेन्द्रश्छित्त्वा च ताँल्लक्ष्मणमाजघान ।शरेण कालाग्निसमप्रभेण स्वयम्भुदत्तेन ललाटदेशे ।। ६.५९.१०४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa tān praciccheda hi rākṣasendraśchittvā ca tām̐llakṣmaṇamājaghāna ।śareṇa kālāgnisamaprabheṇa svayambhudattena lalāṭadeśe ।। 6.59.104 ।।।।

translations.english: Lakshmana also, who is comparable to Mahendra, fitting his bow and arrows that shone like fire released sharp and pointed arrows to put an end to Rakshasa king.

verses.sloka: स लक्ष्मणो रावणसायकार्तश्चचाल चापं शिथिलं प्रगृह्य ।पुनश्च सञ्ज्ञां प्रतिलभ्य कृच्छ्राच्चिच्छेद चापं त्रिदशेन्द्रशत्रोः ।। ६.५९.१०५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa lakṣmaṇo rāvaṇasāyakārtaścacāla cāpaṁ śithilaṁ pragṛhya ।punaśca sañjñāṁ pratilabhya kṛcchrācciccheda cāpaṁ tridaśendraśatroḥ ।। 6.59.105 ।।।।

translations.english: The Rakshasa king broke into pieces those arrows of Lakshmana and struck him on the forehead with the arrow gifted to him by Brahma, that was bright like the fire at the time of universal destruction.

verses.sloka: निकृत्तचापं त्रिभिराजघान बाणैस्तदा दाशरथिः शिताग्रः ।स सायकार्तो विचचाल राजा कृच्छ्राच्च सञ्ज्ञां पुनराससाद ।। ६.५९.१०६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: nikṛttacāpaṁ tribhirājaghāna bāṇaistadā dāśarathiḥ śitāgraḥ ।sa sāyakārto vicacāla rājā kṛcchrācca sañjñāṁ punarāsasāda ।। 6.59.106 ।।।।

translations.english: Lakshmana hurt by Ravana's dart, shaken up, seizing the bow feebly with great difficulty regaining consciousness tore the bow of the enemy of Indra into pieces in return.

verses.sloka: स कृत्तचापः शरताडितश्च मेदार्द्रगात्रो रुधिरावसिक्तः ।जग्राह शक्तिं समुदग्रशक्तिः स्वयम्भुदत्तां युधि देवशत्रुः ।। ६.५९.१०७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa kṛttacāpaḥ śaratāḍitaśca medārdragātro rudhirāvasiktaḥ ।jagrāha śaktiṁ samudagraśaktiḥ svayambhudattāṁ yudhi devaśatruḥ ।। 6.59.107 ।।।।

translations.english: Then Lakshmana son of Dasaratha, struck the bow of the king into pieces with three sharp and pointed arrows. The king swooned and recovered with great difficulty.

verses.sloka: स तां विधूमानलसन्निकाशां वित्रासिनीं वानरवाहिनीनाम् ।चिक्षेप शक्तिं तरसाज्वलन्तीं सौमित्रये राक्षसराष्ट्रनाथः ।। ६.५९.१०८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa tāṁ vidhūmānalasannikāśāṁ vitrāsinīṁ vānaravāhinīnām ।cikṣepa śaktiṁ tarasājvalantīṁ saumitraye rākṣasarāṣṭranāthaḥ ।। 6.59.108 ।।।।

translations.english: Hurt by the arrows, bow cut, bathed in blood, limbs splattered with fat, Ravana the enemy of gods, himself being endowed with formidable energy gifted by the Self born creator seized javelin on the battlefield.

verses.sloka: तामापतन्तीं भरतानुजोग्रैर्जघान बाणैश्च हुताग्निकल्पैः ।तथापि सा तस्य विवेश शक्तिर्बाह्वन्तरं दाशरथेर्विशालम् ।। ६.५९.१०९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tāmāpatantīṁ bharatānujograirjaghāna bāṇaiśca hutāgnikalpaiḥ ।tathāpi sā tasya viveśa śaktirbāhvantaraṁ dāśaratherviśālam ।। 6.59.109 ।।।।

translations.english: The Lord of the world of Rakshasas instantly flung javelin, emitting fire without smoke, on Saumithri, which created fear among Vanaras.

verses.sloka: स शक्तिमान् शक्तिसमाहतः सन् मुहुः प्रजज्वाल रघुप्रवीरः ।तं विह्वलन्तं सहसा ऽभ्युपेत्य जग्राह राजा तरसा भुजाभ्याम् ।। ६.५९.११० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa śaktimān śaktisamāhataḥ san muhuḥ prajajvāla raghupravīraḥ ।taṁ vihvalantaṁ sahasā 'bhyupetya jagrāha rājā tarasā bhujābhyām ।। 6.59.110 ।।।।

translations.english: Lakshmana, the brother of Bharata struck the fierce weapon coming towards him like flames of fire fuelled by ghee, even then it struck him on his broad chest.

verses.sloka: हिमवान् मन्दरो मेरुस्त्रैलोक्यं वा सहामरैः ।शक्यं भुजाभ्यामुद्धर्तु न सङ्ख्ये भरतानुजः ।। ६.५९.१११ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: himavān mandaro merustrailokyaṁ vā sahāmaraiḥ ।śakyaṁ bhujābhyāmuddhartu na saṅkhye bharatānujaḥ ।। 6.59.111 ।।।।

translations.english: Lakshmana the eminent hero of Raghu's was badly hurt by the javelin and was burning in pain. King Ravana caught him who was losing consciousness, violently and held him by his shoulders.

verses.sloka: शक्त्या ब्राह्म्या ऽपि सौमित्रिस्ताडितस्तु स्तनान्तरे ।विष्णोरचिन्त्यं स्वं भागमात्मानं प्रत्यनुस्मरत् ।। ६.५९.११२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: śaktyā brāhmyā 'pi saumitristāḍitastu stanāntare ।viṣṇoracintyaṁ svaṁ bhāgamātmānaṁ pratyanusmarat ।। 6.59.112 ।।।।

translations.english: It may be possible to lift Himalayas, Mandara, Meru mountains or even the Devatas of the three worlds but not possible to lift Lakshmana by shoulders.

verses.sloka: ततो दानवदर्पघ्नं सौमित्रिं देवकण्टकः ।तं पीडयित्वा बाहुभ्यामप्रभुर्लङ्घने ऽभवत् ।अथैवं वैष्णवं भागं मानुषं देहमास्थितम् ।। ६.५९.११३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tato dānavadarpaghnaṁ saumitriṁ devakaṇṭakaḥ ।taṁ pīḍayitvā bāhubhyāmaprabhurlaṅghane 'bhavat ।athaivaṁ vaiṣṇavaṁ bhāgaṁ mānuṣaṁ dehamāsthitam ।। 6.59.113 ।।।।

translations.english: Even though Saumithri was wounded in the chest and the power of Brahma entered (into his chest) he recalled himself as an inconceivable form of Vishnu.

verses.sloka: अथ वायुसुतः क्रुद्धो रावणं समभिद्रवत् ।आजघानोरसि क्रुद्धो वज्रकल्पेन मुष्टिना ।। ६.५९.११४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: atha vāyusutaḥ kruddho rāvaṇaṁ samabhidravat ।ājaghānorasi kruddho vajrakalpena muṣṭinā ।। 6.59.114 ।।।।

translations.english: Thereafter, Ravana the enemy of Devatas was not capable of lifting Lakshmana's shoulders. Lakshmana could crush the pride of Rakshasas.

verses.sloka: तेन मुष्टिप्रहारेण रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः ।जानुभ्यामपतद्भूमौ चचाल च पपात च ।। ६.५९.११५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tena muṣṭiprahāreṇa rāvaṇo rākṣaseśvaraḥ ।jānubhyāmapatadbhūmau cacāla ca papāta ca ।। 6.59.115 ।।।।

translations.english: Then the son of the wind god, enraged, came towards Ravana. Full of anger, he struck him with his thunderbolt like fist on the chest of Ravana.

verses.sloka: आस्यैः सनेत्रश्रवणैर्ववाम रुधिरं बहु ।। ६.५९.११६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: āsyaiḥ sanetraśravaṇairvavāma rudhiraṁ bahu ।। 6.59.116 ।।।।

translations.english: By the blow of Hanuman's fist, Ravana the Lord of Rakshasas was shaken and fell on the ground on his knees.

verses.sloka: विघूर्णमानो निश्चेष्टो रथोपस्थ उपाविशत् ।विसञ्ज्ञो मूर्च्छितश्चासीन्न च स्थानं समालभत् ।। ६.५९.११७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: vighūrṇamāno niśceṣṭo rathopastha upāviśat ।visañjño mūrcchitaścāsīnna ca sthānaṁ samālabhat ।। 6.59.117 ।।।।

translations.english: Much blood flowed from his(Ravana's) mouth, ears, and eyes. Rolling in the hind part of the chariot he became still and sank.

verses.sloka: विसञ्ज्ञं रावणं दृष्ट्वा समरे भीमविक्रमम् ।ऋषयो वानराः सर्वे नेदुर्देवाः सवासवाः ।। ६.५९.११८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: visañjñaṁ rāvaṇaṁ dṛṣṭvā samare bhīmavikramam ।ṛṣayo vānarāḥ sarve nedurdevāḥ savāsavāḥ ।। 6.59.118 ।।।।

translations.english: Ravana of fierce valour having lost senses and waking up from unconscious state, perturbed, did not know where he was. Seeing this the sages, even Vanaras, the demons as well as Devatas shouted in joy.

verses.sloka: हनुमानपि तेजस्वी लक्ष्मणं रावणार्दितम् ।अनयद्राघवाभ्याशं बाहुभ्यां परिगृह्य तम् ।। ६.५९.११९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: hanumānapi tejasvī lakṣmaṇaṁ rāvaṇārditam ।anayadrāghavābhyāśaṁ bāhubhyāṁ parigṛhya tam ।। 6.59.119 ।।।।

translations.english: Brilliant Hanuman holding Lakshmana wounded by Ravana in both shoulders brought him to Rama.

verses.sloka: वायुसूनोः सुहृत्त्वेन भक्त्या परमया च सः ।शत्रूणामप्रकम्प्यो ऽपि लघुत्वमगमत् कपेः ।। ६.५९.१२० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: vāyusūnoḥ suhṛttvena bhaktyā paramayā ca saḥ ।śatrūṇāmaprakampyo 'pi laghutvamagamat kapeḥ ।। 6.59.120 ।।।।

translations.english: Lakshmana though unshakeable for enemies, became light for the son of wind god by his friendship and high devotion.

verses.sloka: तं समुत्सृज्य सा शक्तिः सौमित्रिं युधि दुर्जयम् ।रावणस्य रथे तस्मिन् स्थानं पुनरुपागता ।। ६.५९.१२१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: taṁ samutsṛjya sā śaktiḥ saumitriṁ yudhi durjayam ।rāvaṇasya rathe tasmin sthānaṁ punarupāgatā ।। 6.59.121 ।।।।

translations.english: That power returned back to Ravana's chariot to its position, leaving Lakshmana, who was difficult to vanquish.

verses.sloka: आश्वस्तश्च विशल्यश्च लक्ष्मणः शत्रुसूदनः ।विष्णोर्भागममीमांस्यमात्मानं प्रत्यनुस्मरन् ।। ६.५९.१२२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: āśvastaśca viśalyaśca lakṣmaṇaḥ śatrusūdanaḥ ।viṣṇorbhāgamamīmāṁsyamātmānaṁ pratyanusmaran ।। 6.59.122 ।।।।

translations.english: Lakshmana who could destroy foes, recovering from unconsciousness, relieved of wounds again remembered himself to be part of Vishnu of immeasurable power.

verses.sloka: रावणो ऽपि महातेजाः प्राप्य सञ्ज्ञां महाहवे ।आददे निशितान् बाणान् जग्राह च महद्धनुः ।। ६.५९.१२३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: rāvaṇo 'pi mahātejāḥ prāpya sañjñāṁ mahāhave ।ādade niśitān bāṇān jagrāha ca mahaddhanuḥ ।। 6.59.123 ।।।।

translations.english: Ravana of mighty prowess waking up from consciousness took over his sharp arrows and the great bow also.

verses.sloka: निपातितमहावीरां द्रवन्तीं वानरीं चमूम् ।राघवस्तु रणे दृष्ट्वा रावणं समभिद्रवत् ।। ६.५९.१२४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: nipātitamahāvīrāṁ dravantīṁ vānarīṁ camūm ।rāghavastu raṇe dṛṣṭvā rāvaṇaṁ samabhidravat ।। 6.59.124 ।।।।

translations.english: Raghava also assailed Ravana seeing the fallen Vanara heroes struck in the combat.

verses.sloka: अथैनमुपसङ्गम्य हनुमान् वाक्यमब्रवीत् ।मम पृष्टं समारुह्य राक्षसं शास्तुमर्हसि ।। ६.५९.१२५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: athainamupasaṅgamya hanumān vākyamabravīt ।mama pṛṣṭaṁ samāruhya rākṣasaṁ śāstumarhasi ।। 6.59.125 ।।।।

translations.english: And then Hanuman submitted to Rama, "Just as Lord Vishnu mounted on mighty Garuda, you should also be mounted on my back and subdue Ravana."

verses.sloka: विष्णुर्यथा गरुत्मन्तं बलवन्तं समाहितः ।तच्छुत्वा राघवो वाक्यं वायुपुत्रेण भाषितम् ।आरुरोह महाशूरो बलवन्तं महाकपिम् ।। ६.५९.१२६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: viṣṇuryathā garutmantaṁ balavantaṁ samāhitaḥ ।tacchutvā rāghavo vākyaṁ vāyuputreṇa bhāṣitam ।āruroha mahāśūro balavantaṁ mahākapim ।। 6.59.126 ।।।।

translations.english: And then Hanuman submitted to Rama, "Just as Lord Vishnu mounted on mighty Garuda, you should also be mounted on my back and subdue Ravana."

verses.sloka: रथस्थं रावणं सङ्ख्ये ददर्श मनुजाधिपः ।। ६.५९.१२७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: rathasthaṁ rāvaṇaṁ saṅkhye dadarśa manujādhipaḥ ।। 6.59.127 ।।।।

translations.english: On hearing the sub mission of Hanuman, Sri Rama, the Lord of humans climbed on the great monkey and saw Ravana on the chariot.

verses.sloka: ा राघवो वाक्यं वायुपुत्रेण भाषितम् ।तमालोक्य माहतेजाः प्रदुद्राव स राघवः ।वैरोचनमिव क्रुद्धो विष्णुरभ्युद्यतायुधः ।। ६.५९.१२८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: ā rāghavo vākyaṁ vāyuputreṇa bhāṣitam ।tamālokya māhatejāḥ pradudrāva sa rāghavaḥ ।vairocanamiva kruddho viṣṇurabhyudyatāyudhaḥ ।। 6.59.128 ।।।।

translations.english: Beholding Ravana, highly energetic Rama wielding his bow went furiously towards him just as Lord Vishnu went with his discuss against Virochana.

verses.sloka: ज्याशब्दमकरोत्तीवं वज्रनिष्पेषनिस्वनम् ।। ६.५९.१२९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: jyāśabdamakarottīvaṁ vajraniṣpeṣanisvanam ।। 6.59.129 ।।।।

translations.english: Rama created a sound like a clap of thunder ringing intensely, a majestic one and spoke in a deep voice to the king.

verses.sloka: गिरा गम्भीरया रामो राक्षसेन्द्रमुवाच ह ।। ६.५९.१३० ।। ।।।
verses.transliteration: girā gambhīrayā rāmo rākṣasendramuvāca ha ।। 6.59.130 ।। ।।।

translations.english: "Oh! Tiger among Rakshasas, forbear, forbear. Having done such an offence to me, where are you going for deliverance"

verses.sloka: तिष्ठ तिष्ठ मम त्वं हि कृत्वा विप्रियमीद्दशम् ।क्व नु राक्षसशार्दूल गतो मोक्षमवाप्स्यसि ।। ६.५९.१३१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tiṣṭha tiṣṭha mama tvaṁ hi kṛtvā vipriyamīddaśam ।kva nu rākṣasaśārdūla gato mokṣamavāpsyasi ।। 6.59.131 ।।।।

translations.english: "If you go to Indra or Yama or Sun God or the selfborn Brahma or fire God or Shankara or the ten directions like that, and if you run in front of me you cannot escape."

verses.sloka: यदीन्द्रवैवस्वतभास्करान् वा स्वयम्भुवैश्वानरशङ्करान् वा ।गमिष्यसि त्वं दश वा दिशो ऽथवा तथापि मे नाद्य गतो विमोक्ष्यसे ।। ६.५९.१३२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: yadīndravaivasvatabhāskarān vā svayambhuvaiśvānaraśaṅkarān vā ।gamiṣyasi tvaṁ daśa vā diśo 'thavā tathāpi me nādya gato vimokṣyase ।। 6.59.132 ।।।।

translations.english: "Oh! king of Rakshasa troop! He, who was struck without support now, even if he were to come now in front, you with your sons and grandsons will be struck to death by him."

verses.sloka: यश्चैव शक्त्या ऽभिहतस्त्वया ऽद्य इच्छन् विषादं सहसा ऽभ्युपेतः ।स एव रक्षोगणराज मृत्युः सपुत्रदारस्य तवाद्ययुद्धे ।। ६.५९.१३३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: yaścaiva śaktyā 'bhihatastvayā 'dya icchan viṣādaṁ sahasā 'bhyupetaḥ ।sa eva rakṣogaṇarāja mṛtyuḥ saputradārasya tavādyayuddhe ।। 6.59.133 ।।।।

translations.english: "By me, who is your adversary, fourteen thousand Rakshasas of fierce forms, who had taken abode at Janasthana and used choicest weapons were exterminated."

verses.sloka: एतेन चात्यद्भुतदर्शनानि शरैर्जनस्थानकृतालयानि ।चतुर्दशान्यात्तवरायुधानि रक्षस्सहस्राणि निषूदितानि ।। ६.५९.१३४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: etena cātyadbhutadarśanāni śarairjanasthānakṛtālayāni ।caturdaśānyāttavarāyudhāni rakṣassahasrāṇi niṣūditāni ।। 6.59.134 ।।।।

translations.english: On hearing Raghava's words, the mighty strong king of Rakshasas seized with violent anger, recalling earlier enmity, struck with blazing arrows like tongues of fire at the time of universal destruction while Hanuman bore Rama.

verses.sloka: राघवस्य वचः श्रुत्वा राक्षसेन्द्रो महाकपिम् ।वायुपुत्रं महावीर्यं वहन्तं राघवं रणे ।आजघान शरैस्तीक्ष्णैः कालानलशिखोपमैः ।। ६.५९.१३५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: rāghavasya vacaḥ śrutvā rākṣasendro mahākapim ।vāyuputraṁ mahāvīryaṁ vahantaṁ rāghavaṁ raṇe ।ājaghāna śaraistīkṣṇaiḥ kālānalaśikhopamaiḥ ।। 6.59.135 ।।।।

translations.english: On hearing Raghava's words, the mighty strong king of Rakshasas seized with violent anger, recalling earlier enmity, struck with blazing arrows like tongues of fire at the time of universal destruction while Hanuman bore Rama.

verses.sloka: राक्षसेनाहवे तस्य ताडितस्यापि सायकैः ।स्वभावतेजोयुक्तस्य भूयस्तेजो ऽभ्यवर्धत ।। ६.५९.१३६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: rākṣasenāhave tasya tāḍitasyāpi sāyakaiḥ ।svabhāvatejoyuktasya bhūyastejo 'bhyavardhata ।। 6.59.136 ।।।।

translations.english: Even though Hanuman was hurt by the arrows discharged by the Rakshasa king, being endowed with energy by nature, his energy went on increasing.

verses.sloka: ततो रामो महातेजा रावणेन कृतव्रणम् ।दृष्ट्वा प्लवगशार्दूलं कोपस्य वशमेयिवान् ।। ६.५९.१३७ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tato rāmo mahātejā rāvaṇena kṛtavraṇam ।dṛṣṭvā plavagaśārdūlaṁ kopasya vaśameyivān ।। 6.59.137 ।।।।

translations.english: Seeing the wounds caused by Ravana to Hanuman, the tiger among monkeys, possibly Rama was seized with anger.

verses.sloka: तस्याभिचङ्क्रम्य रथं सचक्रं साश्वध्वजच्छत्रमहापताकम् ।ससारथिं साशनिशूलखड्गं रामः प्रचिच्छेद शरैः सुपुङ्खैः ।। ६.५९.१३८ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tasyābhicaṅkramya rathaṁ sacakraṁ sāśvadhvajacchatramahāpatākam ।sasārathiṁ sāśaniśūlakhaḍgaṁ rāmaḥ praciccheda śaraiḥ supuṅkhaiḥ ।। 6.59.138 ।।।।

translations.english: Advancing towards him, (Ravana), Rama tore into pieces his chariot, wheels, horses, standard and canopy including the charioteer and the darts and swords.

verses.sloka: अथेन्द्रशत्रुं तरसा जघान बाणेन वज्राशनिसन्निभेन ।भुजान्तरे व्यूढसुजातरूपे वज्रेण मेरुं भगवानिवेन्द्रः ।। ६.५९.१३९ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: athendraśatruṁ tarasā jaghāna bāṇena vajrāśanisannibhena ।bhujāntare vyūḍhasujātarūpe vajreṇa meruṁ bhagavānivendraḥ ।। 6.59.139 ।।।।

translations.english: Then with a shining thunderbolt like arrows Rama struck with the weapon of Indra into the fine chest in between the shoulders just as Indra would strike the Meru Mountain with his thunderbolt.

verses.sloka: यो वज्रपाताशनिसन्निपातान्न चुक्षुभे नापि चचाल राजा ।स रामबाणाभिहतो भृशार्तश्चचाल चापं च मुमोच वीरः ।। ६.५९.१४० ।।।।
verses.transliteration: yo vajrapātāśanisannipātānna cukṣubhe nāpi cacāla rājā ।sa rāmabāṇābhihato bhṛśārtaścacāla cāpaṁ ca mumoca vīraḥ ।। 6.59.140 ।।।।

translations.english: He, that heroic king, who was not disturbed hurt by thunderbolt of lightning, was agonized when struck by Rama's arrow and let his bow fall.

verses.sloka: तं विह्वलन्तं प्रसमीक्ष्य रामः समाददे दीप्तमथार्धचन्द्रम् ।तेनार्कवर्णं सहसा किरीटं चिच्छेद रक्षोधिपतेर्महात्मा ।। ६.५९.१४१ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: taṁ vihvalantaṁ prasamīkṣya rāmaḥ samādade dīptamathārdhacandram ।tenārkavarṇaṁ sahasā kirīṭaṁ ciccheda rakṣodhipatermahātmā ।। 6.59.141 ।।।।

translations.english: Seeing Ravana swooning, great soul Rama took up a crescent shaped arrow and hastily broke his crown into pieces which were shining bright red like the Sun.

verses.sloka: तं निर्विषाशीविषसन्निकाशं शान्तार्चिषं सूर्यमिवाप्रकाशम् ।गतश्रियं कृत्तकिरीटकूटमुवाच रामो युधि राक्षसेन्द्रम् ।। ६.५९.१४२ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: taṁ nirviṣāśīviṣasannikāśaṁ śāntārciṣaṁ sūryamivāprakāśam ।gataśriyaṁ kṛttakirīṭakūṭamuvāca rāmo yudhi rākṣasendram ।। 6.59.142 ।।।।

translations.english: Rama said to the king of Rakshasas, who was like a serpent rid of poison without (head) crown, without splendour like the Sun without brightness, his glory lost with the crown broken in the combat.

verses.sloka: कृतं त्वया कर्म महत् सुभीमं हतप्रवीरश्च कृतस्त्वया ऽहम् ।तस्मात् परिश्रान्त इव व्यवस्य न त्वां शरैर्मृत्युवशं नयामि ।। ६.५९.१४३ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: kṛtaṁ tvayā karma mahat subhīmaṁ hatapravīraśca kṛtastvayā 'ham ।tasmāt pariśrānta iva vyavasya na tvāṁ śarairmṛtyuvaśaṁ nayāmi ।। 6.59.143 ।।।।

translations.english: A great task of killing mighty heroes has been accomplished by you. Therefore, you are exhausted. I declare that I will not send you to death.

verses.sloka: गच्छानुजानामि रणार्दितस्त्वं प्रविश्य रात्रिंचरराज लङ्काम् ।आश्वास्य निर्याहि रथी च धन्वी तदा बलं द्रक्ष्यसि मे रथस्थः ।। ६.५९.१४४ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: gacchānujānāmi raṇārditastvaṁ praviśya rātriṁcararāja laṅkām ।āśvāsya niryāhi rathī ca dhanvī tadā balaṁ drakṣyasi me rathasthaḥ ।। 6.59.144 ।।।।

translations.english: "King of night rangers! I know you are agonized after the war. Go to Lanka and rest and reenter, mounted on your chariot with bow. You will witness my strength."

verses.sloka: स एवमुक्तो हतदर्पहर्षो निकृत्तचापः स हताश्वसूतः ।शरार्दितः कृत्तमहाकिरीटो विवेश लङ्कां सहसा स राजा ।। ६.५९.१४५ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: sa evamukto hatadarpaharṣo nikṛttacāpaḥ sa hatāśvasūtaḥ ।śarārditaḥ kṛttamahākirīṭo viveśa laṅkāṁ sahasā sa rājā ।। 6.59.145 ।।।।

translations.english: Rama having spoken in that way (consoling), the king with his vanity and pride crushed, bow broken into pieces, horses and charioteer killed, wounded by arrows, crown broken entered Lanka hastily.

verses.sloka: तस्मिन् प्रविष्टे रजनीचरेन्द्रे महाबले दानवदेवशत्रौ ।हरीन् विशल्यान् सह लक्ष्मणेन चकार रामः परमाहवाग्रे ।। ६.५९.१४६ ।।।।
verses.transliteration: tasmin praviṣṭe rajanīcarendre mahābale dānavadevaśatrau ।harīn viśalyān saha lakṣmaṇena cakāra rāmaḥ paramāhavāgre ।। 6.59.146 ।।।।

translations.english: After the king of prowlers, the enemy of Danavas and Devas entered Lanka, Rama and Lakshmana also drew out the arrows from monkeys in the forefront of the battlefield and went.

verses.sloka: तस्मिन् प्रभिन्ने त्रिदशेन्द्रशत्रौ सुरासुरा भूतगणा दिशश्च ।ससागराः सर्षिमहोरागाश्च तथैव भूम्यम्बुचराश्च हृष्टाः ।। ६.५९.१४७ ।।
verses.transliteration: tasmin prabhinne tridaśendraśatrau surāsurā bhūtagaṇā diśaśca ।sasāgarāḥ sarṣimahorāgāśca tathaiva bhūmyambucarāśca hṛṣṭāḥ ।। 6.59.147 ।।

translations.english: The enemy of Indra having been routed, the suras and asuras, the guardians of the four quarters, including the sea, the large serpents, and sages so also the creatures of land and water were joyful. ।।इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेएकोनषष्टितमस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the fifty ninth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
